fields.description:
## Outcome

Translate the approved WagerTech access matrix into deployable Salesforce metadata and validate it safely in PartialSB.

## Requirements

After the access matrix is approved:

1. Map the approved desired state to Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, layouts, FlexiPages, Custom Permissions, sharing/security metadata as appropriate.
2. Generate the metadata changes in source control / deployment format.
3. Show the proposed diff before deployment.
4. Run deployment validation.
5. Deploy to PartialSB.
6. Regression test the supported personas: Rep, Manager, Ops, Admin.
7. Verify existing guided Flows still function, especially any using Record Field screen components.
8. Document any user/profile/permission-set assignments that require API/script steps rather than metadata deployment.

## Acceptance

* Approved access matrix is implemented without unresolved deviations.
* Normal users cannot obtain broader access through an unintended Profile / Permission Set combination.
* High-risk permissions such as Delete / Edit Read Only Fields match the approved matrix.
* Persona regression testing passes in PartialSB.

Depends on: approved output of the access-matrix consolidation task.
